summary: Follow-up to iteration_9. Verified hardening in /profile client gate: (1) logged-out visit to /profile now redirects to /login?next=%2Fprofile, (2) corrupt localStorage 'user' is cleared before redirect. Ran 5 flows against preview URL — ALL GREEN. No regressions on /packs or /admin.

flow_a_happy_path.steps: /login -> click login-demo-btn -> lands on / with @DemoN chip -> click nav-link-profile -> /profile authenticated

flow_b_deep_link_hardening.steps: fresh context (no cookie/LS) -> GET /profile -> middleware redirects to /login?next=%2Fprofile -> click demo -> lands on /profile (not /)

flow_c_corrupt_localStorage_hardening.steps: authenticated cookie present + set localStorage.user = 'BROKEN-JSON-{{{{' -> visit /profile -> client JSON.parse throws -> LS cleared and redirect to /login?next=/profile
flow_c_corrupt_localStorage_hardening.result: PASS — new hardening works as designed

conclusion: The hardening change (redirect to /login?next=/profile and clear corrupt localStorage) works correctly. Bug 'Demo Account cannot access profile' remains not reproducible, and the new defensive code is verified to run in the intended edge case. No regressions on /packs or /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: profile/page.tsx (lines 40-53): hardening is minimal & correct — JSON.parse in try/catch, removeItem then replace to /login?next=/profile. Good.

Middleware short-circuits BEFORE client-side hardening runs when cookie is missing, so client-side LS cleanup only fires when cookie is present + LS is corrupt (verified in flow C). This is fine but a note: if only LS is present without cookie (impossible in normal flow), edge guard redirects first.
proxy.ts file name is non-standard (Next.js convention is middleware.ts). Still functional but flagged in iteration_9. No action required now.
test_credentials: Demo Account button (ENABLE_DEMO_LOGIN=true). Admin: admin/gachard123 via HTTP Basic.
seed_data_creation: Demo users auto-created via button clicks: Demo14, Demo15, Demo18 (each 10,000 credits).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All demo-login -> profile flows are green including the two new hardenings (next=/profile preservation and corrupt-LS clearance). If a new demo-related report arrives, capture exact browser console + network output; likely will not reproduce.
rca of the issue: N/A — original bug not reproducible. Hardening is an extra safety net now confirmed to run when localStorage.user is corrupt (flow C proves LS is cleared to null and user is redirected to /login?next=/profile instead of a bare /login).
